description: V0.10a live inference repeatability: the sample's recorded requests sent again, unchanged, to the same models on the same server, under four declared conditions. Declared before any request (PLAN.md).

conditions.description: sequential; 5 rounds; in each round every prompt of the model once, in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10a-order/1|interleaved|<round>|<prompt id>')
sequential; each prompt 3 times in a row, prompts in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10a-order/1|back_to_back|<prompt id>')
2 identical requests sent at once, 2 rounds per prompt, prompts in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10a-order/1|concurrent|<prompt id>')
sequential; each prompt 3 times in a row with the request's seed field set to 0, prompts in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v10a-order/1|seeded|<prompt id>')

request.body: the recorded request (model, messages, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, response_format json_object), serialized as the agent serialized it; the seeded condition adds "seed": 0 at the end

unavailable.reason: the server's cache controls (hot-cache and SSD-cache clear) are admin-only, need a key this study does not have, and would affect the server's other users; not authorized
no per-request cache switch in the public request schema; server settings are admin-only; not authorized

would need a model unload or server restart, which affects other users; not authorized. The first request of each prompt in this study is reported as such, with its observed cached tokens, and not called cold

stop.healthBeforeEachBlock: GET /health must answer status healthy; otherwise the study stops

resources: the client runs on the Pi under systemd-run with MemoryMax 1G and nice 10; at most 2 requests in flight

comparison.B_parsed: the content parsed as llm-agent 3 parses it (wrapping stripped, one JSON object) and serialized canonically (sorted keys, no spaces); unparsable is its own value
comparison.C_actions: the parsed actions list (or the details request), canonical JSON; unparsable is its own value
comparison.D_validation: each distinct action list split into llm-agent 3's batches and validated by the engine at the recorded decision point (a replay of the recording); the outcome is each batch's valid flag and refusal codes
comparison.E_decision: no_action, actions (every batch valid), refused (some batch invalid), details, or unparsable
comparison.reference: each request is compared with the prompt's first response in the same condition, and with the original recorded response
